jobs.title: Customer Success Intern
jobs.description:
The Basics:

At Tanium, our Customer Success Interns have the opportunity to learn valuable, real-world experience from the world’s leading customer success organization - responsible for helping the largest organizations on the planet achieve unprecedented visibility and control over the most complex environments in the world. Operating in a highly collaborative team environment, interns will work closely with an assigned 1:1 mentor and other interns on a summer project contributing to our team’s success. A Customer Success Intern can look forward to partnering with senior team members to support customer value realization and use data and qualitative feedback to decide how best to engage resources to drive desired results .

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX

The hourly rate for this internship is $27.00. This hourly rate is an estimate for what Tanium will pay an intern. The actual rate offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, education, skills, training, and experience. In addition to an hourly rate, interns will be eligible for 401k matching and a monthly allowance for communications reimbursement.

What you’ll do:

- Ensure successful business outcomes for customers that lead to world-class retention and expansion for Tanium by collaborating with an account team of Sales, Solution Engineers, Domain Architects, and more

- Work with senior team members to understand the unique complexity and segmentation of the customers Tanium serves and create the best path to full Tanium platform adoption and expansion, leveraging your understanding of not only the customer’s environment but also insights as to how to overcome obstacles to implement new technologies

- Identify where Tanium can be further integrated into customer business processes and controls to increase ROI and expand into new solution areas

- Support strategically focused Executive Business Reviews, alongside Sales, Solution Engineers, and wider account team members

- Work with senior team members to build, manage and maintain strong relationships with customers, peers and partners

- Undergo detailed training in the Tanium platform with the opportunity to become Tanium certified

- Collaborate with your mentor and other interns

- Own a project designed to support our Customer Success efficiency and effectiveness

- Train in top-quality customer-facing sales and presentation skills

- Shadow our full-time Customer Success Managers in their day-to-day operations

We’re looking for someone with:

- Availability to work full-time from June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027

- Undergraduate student currently enrolled in a college or university

- Eligible graduation dates: December 2027 or Spring 2028

- GPA of 3.5 or above

- Able to demonstrate consulting and project management skills

- Able to demonstrate working knowledge of endpoint technology

- Able to demonstrate critical thinking skills

- Skilled at written and verbal communication

- Naturally team-oriented with a mission-first attitude

- Excited to learn new technology

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit  www.tanium.com  and follow us on  LinkedIn  and  X .

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most. Interns and other Tanium contractors are eligible for VTO after 90 days of employment.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact  accommodations@tanium.com . For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here -  https://www.eeoc.gov/poster .

jobs.description:

The Field Marketing Manager will drive regional marketing initiatives that align with sales priorities and accelerate pipeline growth. This role combines strategic expertise with hands-on execution of integrated events. The ideal candidate is a proactive marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and collaborates effectively across teams.

Key responsibilities include:

- Strategic Partnership with Sales: Align marketing strategies with regional sales goals to support quarterly pipeline and revenue targets.

- Integrated Campaign Execution: Collaborate with Product Marketing, Digital, Creative, Events, and Alliances teams to deliver multi-channel programs including email, webinars, direct mail, digital ads, and field events.

- Event Strategy & Execution: Plan and manage impactful regional events that drive mid-funnel engagement and accelerate deal cycles.

- Performance & Optimization: Leverage data-driven insights to measure, analyze, and optimize campaign performance across channels and accounts.

- Sales Enablement & Communication: Maintain strong alignment with Sales on campaign execution, lead follow-up, and feedback loops. Advocate for sales needs and communicate marketing priorities effectively.

- Marketing Operations: Utilize tools such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6Sense, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to execute successful events independently.

This role will primarily support sales teams across the Central and Eastern U.S. regions. Candidates should be located in the Central or Eastern time zones and be comfortable supporting multiple geographies as business needs evolve.

What you’ll do:

- Develop and implement regional field marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.

- Execute integrated events that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.

- Monitor and report on event performance, providing actionable insights for optimization.

- Partner with Sales to ensure seamless lead management and follow-up.

- Manage budgets and timelines for regional marketing programs.

We’re looking for someone with:

- Education:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.

- Experience:

- 3–6 years of B2B enterprise marketing experience, with a strong background in field marketing.

- Proven success in designing and executing integrated programs that drive measurable pipeline and revenue.

- Strategic thinker with strong project management and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Field Technologist, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
The Basics

The Field Technologist, Strategic Partnerships is a field technical role serving as a primary liaison between Tanium’s Customer Org and Product/Engineering teams for our strategic technology partnerships — hyperscalers and cloud providers (Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS), enterprise platform partners (ServiceNow), complementary technology partners (ScreenMeet), and service-provider motions as the portfolio evolves. You will provide technical leadership, support strategic customer and partner engagements, feed real-world input to product teams, and help educate the sales organization on partner value messaging.

You’ll work in a dynamic global environment across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders — from IT and cybersecurity practitioners to senior technical and business leaders — through demonstrations, strategy conversations, roadmap discussions, architecture & design workshops, marketing events, and industry conferences.

What you’ll do

Strategic partnership initiatives

- Serve as the field technical resource for partner integrations and joint solutions across Tanium’s strategic partner ecosystem.

- Analyze partner solutions and roadmaps to identify future integration investment opportunities.

- Engage with partners’ field teams for education, enablement, and opportunity identification.

- Drive enablement for Sales and the Customer Org: value messaging, demonstration qualification, and opportunity identification across the partner portfolio.

- Develop demonstration scripts, solution recordings, and field enablement plans spanning multiple partner integrations.

- Support the technical side of co-sell execution — marketplace transactability, partner-funded programs, and consumption commitments (e.g., Microsoft MACC, AWS EDP).

- Support Tanium’s field positioning for AI and agentic capabilities inside partner platforms (e.g., Microsoft Security Copilot, ServiceNow AI agents) and how Tanium’s real-time endpoint data grounds partner AI workflows.

- Present at marketing events, webinars, and partner sessions.

Partner experience

- Educate and train Tanium partners on technical solution details and cross-vendor solution design.

- Build durable relationships with partner product, engineering, and field teams so integration issues get resolved and roadmap input flows in both directions.

- Serve as a technical resource for questions from partner sellers and their customers during joint pursuits.

- Contribute to joint solution briefs, reference architectures, and partner-facing documentation.

Sales results

- Participate in senior-stakeholder calls to gather input and shape sales-cycle objectives.

- Provide technical leadership and sales advisory support; assist with technical pre-sales as SME.

- Work with the sales team from discovery to close to shorten cycles and improve win rates.

- Architect technical solutions across IT Operations, Security, and Risk teams; align pre-sales and proof-of-value motions with account goals.

Customer, Product, and Enablement support

- Help the Customer Org establish value realization of existing investments and drive adoption where partner integrations are underused.

- Bring field and market insights to R&D and Product; translate field/partner requirements into prioritized integration requests with business case and customer evidence.

- Test new integrations, represent the field in design reviews and pre-release validation, and help create/test technical competency courses and sales enablement materials.

- Maintain a current, versioned library of partner integration enablement content.

We’re looking for someone with

Education

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; CS degree preferred.

Experience

- Working Tanium knowledge or the ability to ramp quickly across the platform.

- Multi-platform technology partner knowledge — solid expertise in at least one (cloud/hyperscaler or enterprise platform) with working fluency across others.

- 6-8+ years in the industry with solid technical skills across networking, security, operations, scripting, and/or programming.

- 5+ years in customer-facing positions; 3+ years in sales and/or strategy-focused roles (consulting, SaaS, global companies).

- Experience supporting strategic pre-sales opportunities.

- Hands-on experience with partner co-sell motions — marketplace transactions, partner-sourced/attached pipeline, referral/reseller mechanics, and partner portals and programs.

- Working knowledge of enterprise AI and agentic platforms and how third-party data grounds them (e.g., Microsoft Security Copilot, ServiceNow AI agents).

- Experience contributing to field enablement: certification paths, demonstration assets, and train-the-trainer programs.

- Comfort operating in ambiguity as the portfolio changes.

- Strong critical thinking, judgment, and independence on complex, loosely-scoped problems.

- Clear communication for senior technical and business stakeholders — workshops, webinars, and partner sessions — with emotional intelligence and influence across extended teams.

Nice to have

- Advanced technical competency (“blackbelt”) program experience.

- Experience supporting EBR/QBR activities or contributing to Enterprise License Agreement (ELA) opportunities.

Work Requirements

- Travel: ~25% to engage with customers, partners, and prospects and to participate in events.

jobs.description:
The Basics:

At Tanium, the Digital Marketing Manager, Japan owns digital awareness, engagement, and pipeline across Tanium’s top enterprise accounts in Japan. This role builds and owns Tanium’s digital marketing engine in Japan — turning global strategy into Japan-market execution through integrated, account-based digital programs that build measurable share of voice within named target accounts and convert engagement into qualified pipeline for the Japan field sales team.

Performance is judged on account penetration, engagement depth, and pipeline contribution within Japan’s most strategic enterprises, with priority focus on BFSI and Critical Infrastructure, and Tanium’s alliance motions with ServiceNow and Microsoft. This role reports to the Director, Japan Marketing.

What you’ll do:

- Building awareness & engagement within named target accounts by:

- Building Tanium’s digital share of voice and brand awareness within Japan’s top enterprise accounts, leading with BFSI and Critical Infrastructure

- Driving and measuring account-level engagement — intent signals, content consumption, web and event interaction — concentrating spend where buying signals are strongest

- Moving accounts deliberately through awareness → engagement → pipeline, reporting on account progression rather than impressions or clicks alone

- Driving pipeline & revenue growth by:

- Converting digital engagement into qualified leads and opportunities, meeting or exceeding quarterly pipeline and NARR targets for Japan

- Optimizing for conversion rate, pipeline velocity, and account penetration — not lead volume in isolation

- Leading account-based & regional campaigns by:

- Planning, launching, and optimizing paid search, paid social, programmatic display, and ABM tailored to Japan segments, buyer personas (CISO, CIO, IT and Security operations leaders), and the named account list

- Transcreating — not merely translating — messaging and creative so it carries cultural, linguistic, and contextual relevance for Japanese enterprise buyers

- Integrating digital with Japan field and event marketing to deliver full-funnel account engagement, including flagship moments such as Converge and regional Tanium events

- Leading cross-functional teams and agency partners to deliver integrated campaigns on time and on budget

- Reporting on performance analytics by:

- Tracking and reporting account-level KPIs — account penetration, engagement rate, intent lift, conversion, ROAS, and pipeline/NARR contribution — with clear, actionable recommendations

- Presenting results to both Japan and global stakeholders, translating Japan-market nuance for HQ and global strategy for the local team

- Owning ABM platform & MarTech by:

- Owning and optimizing the ABM and intent platform and Japan’s use of the global MarTech stack (Marketo, Salesforce), driving engagement and pipeline from target accounts

- Managing budget & vendors by:

- Owning the Japan digital marketing budget, allocating for maximum ROI against the target account mandate

- Managing vendor and agency relationships for quality, accountability, and timely delivery

- Producing localized content & social media by:

- Developing and localizing marketing content including blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, and email campaigns to resonate with the Japanese audience and position Tanium as a thought leader

- Overseeing and managing Tanium Japan’s social media channels, creating engaging and relevant content to build and nurture the online community

- Tracking market insights & innovation by:

- Monitoring Japan digital trends, the local digital ecosystem (Yahoo! Japan, LINE, Japanese search/SEO behavior), competitor activity, and Japanese enterprise buying behavior

- Testing and scaling innovative digital tactics that improve effectiveness and deepen account penetration

We’re looking for someone with:

Education

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field

Experience and Skills

Must Haves:

- 5–7 years in B2B digital marketing, demand generation, or field marketing, with a proven record in Japan-wide enterprise marketing roles

- Demonstrated delivery of pipeline and revenue outcomes through digital channels

- Hands-on expertise across paid search, paid social, programmatic, and ABM

- Advanced proficiency in MarTech platforms — Marketo or Eloqua, Salesforce, and ABM/intent tools

- Strong analytical skills: campaign reporting, optimization, and presenting insight to senior stakeholders

- Native or business-fluent Japanese (written and spoken), with the ability to create, judge, and refine Japanese-language B2B content and creative, paired with business-level English for daily global collaboration

- Deep understanding of Japanese enterprise buying behavior — consensus-driven, multi-stakeholder (稟議 / ringi) decision-making and long, relationship-led cycles — and how to design digital engagement that respects it

- Working knowledge of the Japanese digital ecosystem: Yahoo! Japan, LINE, local search behavior, and Japan-specific SEO

- Familiarity with the Japan B2B media, agency, and partner landscape

- Proven ability to operate as the Japan node of a global marketing organization: adapting global brand, messaging, and campaign frameworks for local execution

- Sales-aligned operator who partners closely with Japan field sales on account selection, engagement, and shared pipeline accountability

Good to Have:

-

- Enterprise software / SaaS marketing experience; cybersecurity, infrastructure, or endpoint experience a distinct advantage

- Experience marketing to security and IT decision-makers (CISO, CIO, Head of Infrastructure)

- Awareness of alliance- and partner-led GTM (e.g., ServiceNow, Microsoft, regional SIs)

Travel Requirements:

Regular domestic travel within Japan required (customer visits, events, partner engagements), with occasional international travel.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.location: Addison, TX (Hybrid); Bellevue, WA (Hybrid); Durham, NC (Hybrid); Emeryville, CA (Hybrid); Reston, VA (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
The Basics:

Tanium's alliances with Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud are among the most important growth levers in the company, and this role owns the marketing side of all three. As Partner Marketing Manager, Cloud Alliances, you are Tanium's marketing face to our cloud partners: the person their partner marketing teams plan with, negotiate with, and build with. You will build joint marketing plans directly with your marketing counterparts at Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud, own budget negotiations with each partner, secure and manage Market Development Funds (MDF), and combine MDF with Tanium's own budget into one funded, coordinated investment plan per partner.

Those plans exist to produce pipeline. This is a builder's role with unambiguous accountability: the campaigns you run must generate Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) that Tanium's telesales team validates and converts into Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) with material pipeline attached. You will design the campaigns, own the lead handoff, tune the funnel with telesales every week, and carry the numbers: MQL volume and quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, and partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.

This is a high-impact senior individual contributor role built for a modern, AI-fluent marketer. Enterprise buyers increasingly research in ChatGPT, Copilot, and Gemini alongside traditional search, so you plan for visibility in AI assistants as deliberately as you plan a conference booth, and you run physical and digital programs as one integrated plan with one pipeline number.

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; Emeryville, CA; or Reston, VA.

What you’ll do:

- Own joint marketing planning with Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud:  Serve as Tanium's single marketing owner for all three cloud alliances. Build trusted, durable relationships with partner marketing, field marketing, and partner development counterparts at each company, and build data-informed, per-partner joint marketing plans aligned to each partner's co-sell and marketplace priorities and to Tanium's pipeline goals. Own the planning cadence end to end: annual and quarterly plan development, regular working sessions, and quarterly business reviews with partner marketing leadership.

- Negotiate and own the joint marketing budget:  Lead budget negotiations with each partner. Secure and manage MDF through the full lifecycle: proposal development, fund requests, execution, claims and compliance, and ROI reporting. Build combined marketing plans funded by MDF plus Tanium budget, make every dollar accountable to pipeline, and defend the investment strategy with data.

- Build the partner demand generation engine:  Design and run always-on, co-branded campaigns targeting joint accounts and each partner's own sellers. Own campaign architecture end to end: audience and account selection, offer and content strategy, channel mix, lead capture, nurture, attribution, and  closed-loop  reporting in Salesforce and  various marketing tools/platforms .

- Own the MQL-to-SQL handoff:  Define lead scoring, routing, and follow-up SLAs with Tanium's  telesales   team  so every partner-generated MQL gets validated fast. Run a standing feedback loop with  telesales  on lead quality, talk tracks, and conversion blockers, and enable them with partner-specific context so MQLs become SQLs with real pipeline attached.

- Make Tanium discoverable in the AI era:  Complement SEO with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO, also known as AEO) so Tanium and joint solution content surfaces in ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, and Perplexity answers. Use AI visibility platforms to measure citations, share of voice, and sentiment, and  optimize  joint content for  citability .

- Run paid programs on established and emerging AI channels:  Plan and optimize paid media on LinkedIn while piloting emerging AI advertising channels, including ChatGPT ads through OpenAI's Ads Manager, ads in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, and Microsoft Copilot sponsored placements, with a disciplined test-and-learn approach and clear success criteria.

- Orchestrate physical and virtual tactics as one integrated plan:  Combine flagship conference presence (Microsoft Ignite, AWS  re:Invent , Google Cloud Next), regional field events, executive dinners and roundtables, and partner-hosted events with webinars, digital campaigns, content syndication, and paid media, all mapped to the same target accounts and pipeline goals, so every physical touch has digital air cover and follow-up built in.

- Measure everything and report it:  Own the funnel dashboard for the cloud alliances: MQL volume and quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline sourced and influenced, cost per SQL, and MDF  utilization  and ROI. Bring the numbers to  partner  QBRs and internal leadership reviews and use them to reallocate budget quickly.

- Represent Tanium externally and advocate internally:  Be a visible presence for Tanium at partner events and executive  engagements, and  serve as the internal champion for cloud alliance marketing across sales,  telesales , alliances, product marketing, and executive stakeholders.

We’re looking for someone with:

- Education:  BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience.

- Experience: 6- 8+ years  of B2B marketing experience, including 3+ years in partner or alliance marketing working directly with at least one  hyperscaler  (Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud).

- Partner funding fluency:  Demonstrated success securing and managing MDF and co-marketing funds end to end, from fund request through execution, claims, and ROI reporting, and navigating partner marketing portals and programs such as Microsoft Partner Center, AWS Partner Central, and Google Cloud Partner Advantage.  You have negotiated funding with a partner and delivered the ROI story afterward.

- Demand generation depth:   A track record  of building full-funnel campaigns accountable for MQL targets, including hands-on work with  telesales , SDR, or inside sales teams on lead scoring, routing, SLAs, and feedback loops, with measurable pipeline to show for it.

- Modern AI fluency:  Daily use of AI tools to accelerate content, campaign operations, and analysis; practical command of both SEO and GEO/AEO; and a strong point of view on AI visibility measurement and emerging AI advertising channels.

- Integrated execution range:  Proven ability to run physical programs (third-party conferences, field events, executive engagements) and virtual programs (webinars, paid digital, content syndication) as one coordinated plan, not separate tracks.

- Negotiation and executive presence:  The credibility to negotiate budgets with some of the largest technology companies in the world, crisp written and verbal communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across partner organizations and internal teams without direct authority.

- Martech  proficiency :  Fluency with Salesforce and a marketing automation platform such as Marketo, with a data-driven approach to campaign measurement and optimization.

- Values alignment:  High integrity and an ownership mindset, with a commitment to doing the right thing, winning as a team, and pursuing excellence in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
